verse_text: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.

blocks.text: Think about the men who have influenced your life.
Who am I becoming that person for?

items: Most men can name who helped build them.
Fewer can name who they are building.
What is the difference between transformation and mission?
